text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two. Cross the legs<n>here...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Awww, I messed up again... I've got<n>to keep
practicing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Big Brother?! Y-you found me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Big Sister?! Y-you found me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I just thought I could get<n>some practice
in since no one was<n>around.
choice_data_list: Why are you practicing by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, when we were having a<n>lesson as a class,
the... um, the power<n>in the studio went out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The lesson was canceled... If I hadn't<n>been there,
I'm sure that wouldn't<n>have happened...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I made a big mess for everyone...<n>That's why I'm
practicing alone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You should leave before something<n>bad happens
to you too, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You should leave before something<n>bad happens
to you too, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not it! I don't mind you<n>being here!
choice_data_list: In that case, let me help you train.

her weaknesses when<n>dancing.
